A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual held the position of '''prince-regent''' in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The prince-regent had a number of heirlooms stolen from him, and paid large sums to recover the stolen heirlooms.
